title: Connected in orbit
description: Three labels circle one idea while staying upright.
useCase: Illustrate a small set of related tools, stages or capabilities.
reducedMotion: All labels remain at fixed, evenly spaced positions.
limitations: This is an illustrative diagram, not interactive navigation. Keep labels short and preserve the accessible description.
look: Pale blue-grey field with a dark slate rounded-square hub, solid and dashed concentric rings, and three small white circle labels on the outer ring.
motion: Three labels revolve around the hub once every 24 s at constant linear speed, counter-rotating so their text stays upright; a button pauses the orbit.
adapt: The orbit is the `mg-orbit-travel` keyframes (`rotate(var(--angle)) translateY(86px)` then counter-rotate) at `24s linear infinite`; each item's start `--angle` is `i * 120 + 60`. Replace `items` and the centre label, changing `86px` in both places to set the radius.
